On May 11, 2024, police received a report of a stolen vehicle traveling through Glendale, WI. Upon attempting to intercept the vehicle, the male driver recklessly fled at high speeds. After a few miles, the suspect collided with two vehicles and fled on foot. During the ensuing foot pursuit by police, an officer was obstructed by another squad car, leading to a collision where he lost balance and struck the squad car head-on.
